observations.behavior: Adds documentation explaining that an explicit $ai_session_id takes priority over gen_ai.conversation.id, and that gen_ai.conversation.id can be used as a fallback session ID if no explicit session ID exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a fallback session ID assignment using the OpenTelemetry gen_ai.conversation.id attribute when no explicit PostHog session ID is present, preserving the conversation ID on the event. This supports users of Vercel AI or other providers that emit conversation IDs without explicit PostHog session IDs, while still allowing middleware or explicit session IDs to take precedence.

observations.behavior: Adds Anthropic middleware to the middleware registry and its execution order, alongside an explicit fallback session ID assignment after middleware processing.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds Anthropic as a supported OpenTelemetry library and its middleware, while also adding a fallback session ID assignment using the conversation ID. This could help users of Anthropic or other providers that emit conversation IDs without explicit PostHog session IDs, while still allowing middleware or explicit session IDs to take precedence.
